# Overview

My dataset is from fruit production and physiology. It consists data for various fruit quality measurements. The data were collected on field and laboratory. Both qualitative and quantitative data are collected. There are 100 ovservations and 11 variables are measured.


# Research Questions

1. How to analyse qualitative and quantitave data?
2. How to visualize data using ggplot?
3. How to reprduce data?

# Rationale

This dataset intrests me because I will be researching on the similar projects which investigates about how different types of pruning practices in fruit trees impacts overall fruit quality and consumer preference. Additionally, I hope to learn how to analyse these qualitative and quantitative data using R and also to visualize the results for doing presentations at various conferences and workshops.


## File 1: measurements.csv


```{r read-file-1}
file1 <- read.csv("data/raw/measurement.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = "")
```

This file has `100` rows and `14` columns. Here are the first few rows:

```{r head-file-1}
knitr::kable(head(file1))
```

And here is the type of each column, as R reads it:

```{r str-file-1}
str(file1)
```

### Data dictionary for file 1

| Variable | Description | Type | Units |
|----------|-------------|------|-------|
| `tree_id` | Numbers each trees for which data is taken | whole number  | none|
| `measurement_id` | Indicates each measurement event | whole number | none|
